brief:
Israeli National Security Minister Itamar Ben-Gvir posted an artificially generated video depicting a starving Palestinian amid preparations for upcoming elections, according to Al Jazeera English. The video, created using artificial intelligence, showed imagery of Palestinian suffering.

Ben-Gvir, who leads the far-right Otzma Yehudit party, released the material as Israel moves toward electoral voting. The minister has not publicly explained the video's intended message or rationale for its distribution during the campaign period.
dek: Ben-Gvir posts AI video of starving Palestinian ahead of elections.
title: Ben-Gvir posts AI-generated video of starving Palestinian before elections
